title: Draft: KMS Rotation Evidence Template + Audit Checklist
content:
Purpose
- This document is a fillable template + checklist to capture evidence for KMS key rotation activities (KEK/DEK envelope encryption flows) across Redwood deployments.
- Goal: make evidence collection repeatable and consistent for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 audits and for enterprise customer security reviews.

Status / notes
- DRAFT (v0.3). Expect changes as wrapper + rotation tooling lands.
- Template is designed to be:
  (1) automation-friendly (can be generated from audit logs + CI outputs)
  (2) human-reviewable (sign-offs + screenshots/exports)

Where to store completed evidence
- Internal audits: store completed packet in: shared_drives/security-and-compliance/audit-evidence/YYYY/QX/kms-rotation/
- Customer-provided evidence (Private): store in customer folder + attach sanitized excerpt to support ticket if requested.

Definitions (lightweight)
- KEK: Key Encryption Key (KMS/HSM-managed master key) used to encrypt DEKs.
- DEK: Data Encryption Key used to encrypt data at rest (stored encrypted as envelope).
- Dual-read window: period during which decrypt attempts allow both old and new key versions (or key IDs) to avoid hard cutover failures.
- Cutover: change that makes new encryption writes use the new key version.
- Rollback: revert cutover flags and/or allowed decrypt key set to restore service.

Scope
In-scope systems (typical)
- Control plane: key references, config flags, rotation toggles, audit logging of rotation events.
- Data plane: runtime decrypt/envelope operations, KMS client wrapper metrics/errors.
- Private installer / preflight: KMS permissions and key ID validation.

Out of scope
- Net-new cryptographic primitives / algorithm changes.
- Non-KMS secrets rotation (unless specifically coupled to KMS roles used for rotation).

Rotation event summary (to be completed)
- Rotation ID (unique): _______________________________
- Rotation type: [ ] Scheduled quarterly  [ ] Scheduled annual  [ ] Emergency  [ ] Customer-requested  [ ] Other: __________
- Environment(s): [ ] Hosted  [ ] Dedicated  [ ] Private (customer)  [ ] Staging  [ ] Other: __________
- Cloud / provider: [ ] AWS KMS  [ ] GCP KMS  [ ] Azure Key Vault  [ ] HSM-backed (provider): __________
- Regions impacted: _______________________________
- Services impacted (list): _______________________________
- Primary on-call / executor: _______________________________
- Security approver: _______________________________
- SRE approver: _______________________________
- Customer contact (if Private): _______________________________

Key material identifiers (record actual IDs/ARNs; redact in customer-shared copies if required)
- Old key identifier(s)
  - Key ID/ARN: _______________________________
  - Key version (if applicable): _______________________________
- New key identifier(s)
  - Key ID/ARN: _______________________________
  - Key version (if applicable): _______________________________
- Key alias(es) used (if applicable): _______________________________
- KMS key policy / IAM principal used by runtime decrypt:
  - Principal/Role: _______________________________
  - Policy version / commit / module version: _______________________________
- KMS key policy / IAM principal used by rotation tooling (should be separate when supported):
  - Principal/Role: _______________________________
  - Policy version / commit / module version: _______________________________

Approvals & change management (evidence required)
Checklist
[ ] Change ticket created (Linear/Jira) and linked to rotation ID
[ ] Risk review completed (if production) per Security & Compliance guidelines
[ ] SRE sign-off on rollback criteria + alerting readiness
[ ] Customer approval recorded (Private only) if rotation impacts customer-managed keys or requires downtime/maintenance window

Fillable fields
- Primary change ticket:
  - System: [ ] Linear  [ ] Jira  [ ] Other
  - ID/Link: _______________________________
  - Title: _______________________________
  - Owner: _______________________________
- Secondary tickets (optional): _______________________________
- Approval evidence (links to threads/emails) (attach as PDFs/screenshots when needed):
  - Security approval link: _______________________________
  - SRE approval link: _______________________________
  - Product/PM approval link (if customer-facing comms): _______________________________
  - Customer approval link (Private): _______________________________

Implementation artifacts (what changed)
Checklist
[ ] PR(s) merged for rotation or related guardrails (if applicable)
[ ] Config change(s) recorded (flags, key IDs, allowed decrypt sets)
[ ] Terraform/installer module versions captured (Private/Dedicated)

Fillable fields
- GitHub PR(s) (links):
  - _______________________________
  - _______________________________
- Deploy / release identifiers:
  - Control plane deploy ID / SHA: _______________________________
  - Data plane deploy ID / SHA: _______________________________
  - Installer version (Private): _______________________________
  - Terraform module version: _______________________________
- Config changes (explicit):
  - Flag / setting: ____________________  Old value: __________  New value: __________  Applied at: __________
  - Flag / setting: ____________________  Old value: __________  New value: __________  Applied at: __________

Rotation timeline (timestamps in UTC)
Instructions
- Capture start/end times + key checkpoints.
- Prefer exported audit logs over manual notes. Manual notes acceptable if linked to logs.

Timeline table (fill)
- T0 Rotation initiated
  - Timestamp (UTC): ____________________
  - Initiated by (user/service): ____________________
  - Evidence: [ ] Audit log export  [ ] CI log  [ ] Screenshot  [ ] Other: __________  Link: ____________________
- T1 Dual-read enabled (if used)
  - Timestamp (UTC): ____________________
  - Scope (services/regions): ____________________
  - Evidence link: ____________________
- T2 New key version available / verified in KMS
  - Timestamp (UTC): ____________________
  - Evidence link (KMS event/export): ____________________
- T3 Cutover for encryption writes
  - Timestamp (UTC): ____________________
  - Cutover criteria met? [ ] yes  [ ] no  Notes: ____________________
  - Evidence link: ____________________
- T4 Validation window completed
  - Timestamp (UTC): ____________________
  - Duration: ____________________
  - Evidence (dashboards/logs): ____________________
- T5 Old key version deprecation step (if applicable)
  - Timestamp (UTC): ____________________
  - Action: [ ] disable old key  [ ] restrict policy  [ ] remove decrypt allowance  [ ] scheduled later
  - Evidence link: ____________________
- T6 Rotation complete
  - Timestamp (UTC): ____________________
  - Declared by: ____________________
  - Evidence link: ____________________

Required observability evidence (attach exports)
Minimum expectations (production)
- KMS dependency health before/during/after:
  - Latency (p50/p95/p99) for KMS calls
  - Error rate by canonical taxonomy (AccessDenied, NotFound, Throttling, Timeout, InvalidCiphertext)
  - Circuit breaker state changes (open/half-open/closed) if enabled
- Application impact:
  - 5xx rate, decrypt failures, request latency impact (if any)

Checklist
[ ] Dashboard snapshot(s) covering 1h before start through 1h after cutover (or longer if extended window)
[ ] Query/export showing KMS error taxonomy counts during the change
[ ] Evidence that alerting did not trigger OR if triggered, incident record attached

Fillable fields
- Dashboard links:
  - KMS health dashboard: _______________________________
  - Service error dashboard: _______________________________
  - Tracing view (KMS spans): _______________________________
- Metric exports attached? [ ] yes [ ] no
  - Export file path(s): _______________________________
- Log queries used (copy/paste exact query):
  - Query 1: ___________________________________________
  - Query 2: ___________________________________________

Audit log evidence (rotation events)
What to collect
- Explicit rotation-related audit events (e.g., key version updates, cutover toggles, dual-read enable/disable)
- Actor identity (human vs service principal)
- Timestamp (UTC)
- Target scope (environment/region/service)

Checklist
[ ] Audit log export generated for the rotation window
[ ] Export includes rotation events (verify schema includes kms_rotation_* fields)
[ ] Export stored in evidence folder with immutable naming

Fillable fields
- Audit log export method: [ ] audit-log-exporter  [ ] SIEM export  [ ] console export  [ ] other: __________
- Export time range (UTC): ____________________ to ____________________
- Export file name: ____________________
- Storage location: ____________________
- Verification step performed by: ____________________  Date: ____________________

Access control / IAM evidence
What auditors typically ask
- Who can rotate keys / change key references?
- Is runtime decrypt access separated from rotation access?
- Evidence of least privilege (scoped key ARNs, scoped actions, scoped principals)
- Break-glass access controls and expiry

Checklist
[ ] IAM policy documents captured (or Terraform plan/apply logs) showing exact permissions
[ ] Principal separation documented (runtime vs rotation) OR exception approved
[ ] Break-glass access usage checked (and recorded as none / used with ticket)

Fillable fields
- IAM artifacts
  - Terraform plan/apply logs link: ____________________
  - Policy document snapshot link: ____________________
  - Role ARNs/principals: ____________________
- Break-glass usage
  - Used? [ ] no  [ ] yes
  - If yes: ticket ID/link: ____________________  Access start/end: ____________________  Approver: ____________________

Validation / correctness evidence
Goal
- Prove that decrypt works for both old and new encrypted material during the window (where dual-read applies) and that new writes use the new key after cutover.

Checklist (pick relevant)
[ ] Canary validation succeeded (single region/service)
[ ] Test vector / sample ciphertext successfully decrypted with new configuration
[ ] No increase in InvalidCiphertext or decrypt failure rates post-cutover
[ ] Smoke tests run (control plane + data plane)
[ ] Private installer preflight validation report attached (Private only)

Fillable fields
- Validation method(s): [ ] automated test  [ ] manual runbook  [ ] customer validation  [ ] other: __________
- Automated test run link(s): _______________________________
- Preflight validation report (Private): _______________________________
- Notes on any anomalies: _______________________________

Exceptions / deviations (if any)
Use this section if rotation did not follow the standard playbook.

Fillable fields
- Exception requested? [ ] no  [ ] yes
- Exception type: [ ] delayed rotation  [ ] no dual-read available  [ ] shared principal  [ ] other: _________
- Reason / customer constraint: _______________________________
- Compensating controls: _______________________________
- Approval link (CISO/GRC as required): _______________________________

Incident linkage (if any issues occurred)
Checklist
[ ] Incident created (if paging / customer impact)
[ ] Postmortem link attached
[ ] Follow-up tickets created and linked

Fillable fields
- Incident link / ID: _______________________________
- Customer support tickets (if any): _______________________________
- Postmortem link: _______________________________
- Follow-up tasks (IDs): _______________________________

Final sign-off
Attestation (internal)
“I confirm the above rotation was executed according to Redwood’s key management standard and that attached evidence is complete to the best of my knowledge.”

- Executor name: ____________________  Title: ____________________  Date (UTC): ____________________  Signature/OK: ____________________
- Security reviewer: ____________________  Date (UTC): ____________________  Signature/OK: ____________________
- SRE reviewer: ____________________  Date (UTC): ____________________  Signature/OK: ____________________
- (Optional) Product/Customer reviewer (Private): ____________________  Date (UTC): ____________________  Signature/OK: ____________________

Appendix A: Evidence packet naming conventions (proposed)
- Folder: YYYY/QX/kms-rotation/<rotation-id>/
- Files:
  - 01-change-ticket-links.txt
  - 02-approvals-screenshots.pdf
  - 03-audit-log-export.jsonl.gz
  - 04-metrics-export.csv
  - 05-dashboard-snapshots.pdf
  - 06-validation-results.txt
  - 07-iam-artifacts.pdf
  - 08-final-signoff.txt

Appendix B: Notes to template maintainers (open questions)
- Do we want a separate template per deployment mode (Hosted vs Private), or keep one with toggles?
- Confirm which audit log event names are final (kms_rotation_cutover_set? kms_key_reference_updated?).
- Confirm minimum retention / where we store exports for SOC2 evidence.
- Confirm if we require dual-read for all services or allow exceptions (with documented risk acceptance).
